notes.title: RobotDog Update is here!
notes.content:
New features:[list]
[*]Now you can play as a Robot Dog!
[*]RobotDog Tutorial Levels
[*]RobotDog Regular Levels, where you have to switch between dog and human form.
[*]Some old, advanced levels now support changing between human and dog.
[*]When RobotDog flips on it's back, contextual help will show you how to flip in on legs.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=mCsFO6pA7D8;full][/previewyoutube]

Changes:[list]
[*]I changed some controls for gamepad (grab, crouch)
[*]Gamepad now supports analog joysticks for navigation in the menu.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=5q51XUzqRv8;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=oOT71a_oJVw;full][/previewyoutube]

Please report Bugs and things you Like / Hate.
I would like to fully release Cybermotion, in the beginning of 2024.
Thank you for your patience.

notes.title: Future of Cybermotion Early Access
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29757025/668c86ef53778f836362abb0e93b03575c28bfab.png[/img]

Hello, I am still working on UE4 3d remake/update.
I want UE4 version with similar levels, and with gameplay identical to 2d version. However, lot of levels will be different. Some less popular features will be missing.

New features:
[list]
    [*]you can see how many tries you needed to get medal, or finish level
    [*]robot can turn 180 degrees any time, so you can go left too
    [*]box-cartoon scenery can be attached to moving objects in level
    [*]new types of obstacles
[/list]

New additional level types:
[list]
    [*]Levels with score counter instead of time counter
    [*]Levels at theatre with cartoon scenery(fairytale themed for example)
[/list]


Early Access will kind of start all over again. First UE4 update will  be like first update on 2d version, so avoid it, if you don't want to help with testing and debuging.

Thank you for patience

[*]robot can turn 180 degrees any time, so you can go left too
[*]box-cartoon scenery can be attached to moving objects in level
[*]new types of obstacles
[*]Levels with score counter instead of time counter
[*]Levels at theatre with cartoon scenery(fairytale themed for example)

notes.title: Early Access update 0.14
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29757025/2021f21f348160b75e258e932b61881ff5cb97b1.png[/img]
[h1]10 New Levels!!! Arms update !!! [/h1]
[list]
[*]New Upgrade: snappy hands (ability to snap, hold, climb)
[*]New Feature: using hands to snap, hold, climb 
(AI assisted movement based on inverse kinematics)
[*]New Object: Gymnastic bar (can be used for swinging around then, 
really long jumps)
[*]New Object: Holder (you can climb on them, or swing)
[*]New Object: Button, can control machines (only manipulators for now)
[*]New Function: You can sell upgrades for 85% of the original cost
[*]New Function: when you are holding box, or hanging, 
arrow keys have special moves
[*]New Feature: Achivements!! for gold medals 
(more creative achievements on the way)
6 out of 12 achievements are possible to unlock right now
[*]New ideology: Some levels now require certain upgrades, that's why I made "sell upgrade"
function. Old ideology was to make all levels playable without any upgrades, 
but I had chained hands while designing some levels.
[*]New Tutorials: New tutorials in some old levels and new levels
[*]Bug fix: Tutorial videos in TV's are no longer stealing framerate
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access update 0.12
notes.content:
[h1]Level Editor Update![/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29757025/ee0dcd41c862ff343367d5f60616416cad97e55b.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*]Editor: Level editor has new tutorial!
[*]Editor: Level editor was simplified,  and you can do more things in it now
[*]Editor: Humans can be used and edited in level editor
[*]Editor: Manipulators are now much easier to use and animate
[*]Upgrade: Big feet upgrade was redesigned (also graphically) and is no longer useless
[*]Upgrade: Stun Protection upgrades also increese force needed to rip robot's head of
[*]Upgrade: Overclocking Upgrades 4 and 5 were removed, because their effect was too strong and uncomfrtable
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29757025/f1a2b3990928c6d3154d78c50430643ea90d6ee6.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]Visuals: human is now controlling the cage, in which you are chained in early levels
[*]Visuals: screen turns black and white when stunned
[*]Experimental: left and right arrow keys move with arms, while another animation is playing
[*]Function: Levels where you are chained to metal construction no longer need loading
[*]Function: You can make steam screenshots now (F12)
[*]Bug fixed: joints were much more durrable when Over-Clocked
[*]Several bug fixes
[/list]

Send Me your creations (pinned discussion)

I am sorry for the lack of new levels. Next update will be very soon.

notes.title: Early Access update 0.07
notes.content:
Small percentage of people can't start the game properly,
If you only see black / white screen, sounds on background.
I am very sorry for this issue. Please check if your PC matches at least the minimum system requirements and please go to discussions, there is pinned discussion "Game does not work?"  you can find tips, which helped some people with this issue.
Fixing this problem is my main priority now, please be patient.
Please try to run the game after every update and tell me if its better, please

-Tutorial televisions were added to more leves, or better places
-several bug fixes
-some levels were edited
